# Vendored Assets

## `gsap.min.js`
- **Version:** GSAP 3.15.0
- **Source:** `npm` package `gsap@3.15.0` (`dist/gsap.min.js`)
- **License:** GreenSock Standard "no charge" license (<https://gsap.com/standard-license>), free for commercial and non-commercial use.
- **Usage:** Inlined into self-contained HTML motion-graphic scenes by `src/parallax/html_motion.py` so headless Chromium rendering works completely offline with zero network requests.
